question: The East India Company Act, 1813, is also known as the ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Charter Act**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The East India Company Act, 1813, is also known as the **Charter Act**.
 
• This act was an important legislative measure enacted by the British Parliament.
 
• It ended the trade monopoly of the East India Company in India, except for the trade in tea and trade with China.
 
• The act allowed missionaries to enter British India and promote education and religious activities.
 
• It also provided for the establishment of a regular system of courts and the codification of laws.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Charter Act of 1813 is part of a series of Charter Acts that were enacted by the British Parliament to regulate the affairs of the East India Company.
 
• Other significant Charter Acts include the Charter Act of 1833 and the Charter Act of 1853, which further reformed the administration of British India.
 
• The East India Company, established in 1600, played a crucial role in the colonization and administration of India until its dissolution in 1858 following the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
 
• The Government of India Act 1858 transferred the control of India from the East India Company to the British Crown.
